description: AI-21 (#302): promo access and pending discounts, owner-scoped popup preferences and experiment metrics. Payments remain separate work (#79); the owner console and admin UI are Epic #398.

conventions.auth: Bearer token; account always comes from its subject
conventions.request: JSON object with exactly the documented fields; at most 2048 bytes, depth 3 and 64 nodes
conventions.errors: RFC 9457 Problem Details with a stable code; no plaintext promo code or sensitive diagnostics
conventions.timestamps: RFC 3339 UTC; month gifts and displayed dates use learning.usage.calendar-zone (Europe/Moscow)

endpoints.auth: learning.write and verified email confirmed by Identity

request.code: string, raw at most 64 characters; normalized ASCII uppercase, whitespace/dashes/underscores removed; normalized length 8..24, A-Z0-9

response.discount: {type DISCOUNT_PERCENT, plan PLUS|PRO|null, percent integer 1..90, validUntil, message}

notes: Retry an unknown outcome with the same key and equivalent normalized code; a different normalized code under the key conflicts.
Tier access writes an entitlement snapshot without auto-renewal; gifts do not stack their durations. A lower tier than current access is refused without burning the code.
A discount is pending billing data, grants no rights and is not applied to the displayed catalog price. A weaker/equal pending discount is refused without burning the code.
Configured defaults: 5 attempts/account/hour, 20/address/hour; trusted-proxy address resolution and IPv6 /64 grouping. Address and device evidence are keyed hashes.
Code-row locking enforces the global activation cap; once-per-account is enforced in storage. Expiry is checked after contended redemption locks.
Production redemption/creation is unavailable without a nonblank promo hashing secret of at least 32 characters. Plain codes and unkeyed guess-verification fingerprints are never stored or logged.

endpoints.auth: learning.read and administrator confirmed by Identity on every privileged request without the standing cache; fail closed
endpoints.response: {codes: [adminCodeView] (at most 200), next: UUID|null}; next is the last returned id, passed as after

endpoints.auth: learning.write and administrator confirmed by Identity on every privileged request
endpoints.request: {type TIER_DAYS|TIER_MONTHS|DISCOUNT_PERCENT, maxRedemptions integer 1..1000000, plan PLUS|PRO|null, days integer 1..366|null, months integer 1..24|null, percent integer 1..90|null, validFrom RFC 3339|null, validUntil RFC 3339|null, oncePerAccount boolean|null, channel string|null, code string}; type, maxRedemptions and code required, others optional
notes: TIER_DAYS requires plan and days only; TIER_MONTHS requires plan and months only; DISCOUNT_PERCENT requires percent and validUntil, optionally plan. MAX is unavailable.
validFrom defaults to now, validUntil must be later than validFrom; oncePerAccount defaults true; channel matches [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9 _.:/@#+-]{0,39}.

code is required (the console generates 12 unambiguous random characters, approximately 60 bits, in the browser; there is no server-side generator) and uses redemption normalization. Idempotency-Key is required: a request without it or without code is 400. The response (and an exact replay of the same key, actor and payload) is the only plaintext retrieval; a code already in use is 400 code_taken.
PATCH {enabled} is idempotent: repeating the current state returns the code and writes no journal entry; only an actual change appends PROMO_ENABLE or PROMO_DISABLE.

endpoints.auth: learning.write and administrator confirmed by Identity
notes: Disabling a code stops future redemptions and preserves access already granted.

endpoints.response: {eligible boolean, campaign null|{id (at most 60), title (120), body (500), cta (40), code null|string (64)}}
notes: No popup while the campaign is disabled, after any BILLING snapshot or permanent decline, or during the configured 7..30-day dismissal cooldown.
The client presents at natural breakpoints and at most once per session, including when sessionStorage is unavailable. Account changes fence outstanding responses.

endpoints.response: 204 with empty body and Promo-Event-Recorded: true|false
notes: true acknowledges the atomic preference/event write; false means a disabled-campaign no-op. A mismatched active campaign is INVALID_REQUEST.
A failed or unrecorded dismissal/decline remains locally pending and suppressed, with bounded retry of the same account-scoped event; a successful HTTP status alone does not prove storage.
DECLINED is permanent; DISMISSED begins server cooldown. Repeating an event is safe for eligibility, but repeating a dismissal refreshes its timestamp.
A local explicit decline remains suppressed on that device; it is not proof of a recorded preference on other devices. The local receipt contains only campaign id, event and confirmation state.

endpoints.response: 204 with empty body; malformed body 400; throttled event 429 with Retry-After
notes: The variant is the server HMAC assignment returned in /plans, never a client claim; without an assignment secret, control is used. Unknown/disabled experiments produce no counter.

Known events are limited to 30/account/minute per process; the tracking table holds at most 20000 accounts. When full, an untracked account receives 429 with a 5-second retry rather than bypassing the limit. Unknown/disabled experiments consume no tracking capacity.
mnema_experiment_events_total labels contain only bounded experiment key, configured variant and event, never an account/address/code.
CONVERSION measures CTA intent while payments (#79) are unavailable; it does not represent a purchase.

shapes.adminCodeView: {codeId UUID, hint, type, plan PLUS|PRO|null, days integer|null, months integer|null, percent integer|null, validFrom, validUntil|null, maxRedemptions, oncePerAccount, channel|null, enabled, redemptions integer, createdAt}
